faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gujarat University Teaching Assistant in Psychology recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Gujarat University Teaching Assistant in Psychology recruitment is 16th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Teaching Assistant in Psychology post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Teaching Assistant in Psychology post at Gujarat University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Psychology (M.A.) with at least 55% marks and have qualified UGC-NET/GSET. A Ph.D. in Psychology may exempt candidates from the NET/GSET requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Teaching Assistant in Psychology role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Application Review followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Gujarat University located?
faq.answer: Gujarat University is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, which will direct you to the relevant pages on the Gujarat University website.
